errors.text: The proposed getter is excess ZrH2 rather than titanium sponge; adding excess ZrH2 also compromises the intended equiatomic alloy composition.
The asserted decomposition order is opposite to the target sequence: the target reports Ta→Nb→Hf/Ti/Zr, whereas the hypothesis places ZrH2 first and TaH0.5 last.
The 1350°C/2 h regime omits hydrogen de-binding and does not reconstruct the 1400°C/18 h vacuum sintering followed by quenching from 1500°C.
The oxygen boundary of <0.1 wt.% contradicts the approximately 1.0 wt.% oxygen condition associated with the reported phase stability and interstitial strengthening.
The predicted grain size below 10 µm conflicts with the post-quench result of 33 ± 19 µm.
